# Vanta Waves — pinned local distribution

- Vanta 0.5.24, npm package `vanta`, `dist/vanta.waves.min.js`.
- Three.js 0.134.0, npm package `three`, `build/three.min.js`.
- Sources: https://github.com/tengbao/vanta and https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- MIT license notices included alongside each distribution.

Loaded only in the browser by WaveBackground, from the same origin. No CDN,
telemetry, input capture, or CSP changes. Update these versions together and
verify WebGL rendering, teardown, reduced motion, and the static fallback.
